description.en: Self-hosted index for Account Sync: cross-terminal sync of plugins, settings, workspace files, sessions and skills for one DeepSeek account.
description.zh: 账号同步的自建索引：同一 DeepSeek 账号下的多终端插件、设置、工作区文件、会话与技能同步。

description.en: Keeps the same account's terminals in sync: installed plugins and enablement, app settings, selected workspace files, session logs, and skills / agent presets. Folder, git, WebDAV and LAN transports; every content category is an independent toggle; dry-run plan, conflict copies and additive-only session import.
description.zh: 让同一账号下的多台终端保持一致：已安装插件及启用状态、应用设置、选定的工作区文件、会话记录、技能 / Agent 预设。支持共享文件夹、Git、WebDAV、局域网四种传输方式；每类内容独立开关；支持预演计划、冲突副本，会话只做增量导入。
